reasons.auth: The API uses Bearer tokens (access tokens) for authentication, as shown in the code samples and documentation for REST and GraphQL endpoints.
reasons.access: Developers can sign up for a free BigCommerce trial store to test API access, which provides working credentials for a limited time.
reasons.mcp: BigCommerce provides an official MCP server for its documentation and API tools, documented at docs.bigcommerce.com.
reasons.verdict: Public documentation and self-serve trial credentials are available, allowing a toolkit to be built immediately for testing and development.

rounds.change_log: Retained self_serve_free as the primary access tier since BigCommerce offers a free trial/sandbox store sign-up to obtain working API credentials without immediate payment.

reasons.auth: The public API documents OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Grant for single-click apps (recommended) and API tokens (X-Auth-Token/Bearer) for connector apps or direct integration.
reasons.access: Developers can sign up for a free trial store or request a free non-transactional sandbox store to obtain working credentials without payment or approval hurdles.
reasons.mcp: The documentation explicitly instructs AI clients to connect to the official MCP server at https://docs.bigcommerce.com/_mcp/server.
reasons.verdict: Public documentation is available, and self-serve free credentials (trial/sandbox) allow a toolkit to be built immediately.
